title: How to Increase Nitric Oxide Naturally: 6 Best Ways

## Hydration and Nitric Oxide Levels  
Water helps to facilitate the biochemical process of nitric acid production. This means that proper hydration is critical for nitric acid synthesis. Proper hydration also supports blood flow which helps the function of endothelial cells that are responsible for nitric oxide release.  
Hydration also helps to keep the electrolyte and nutrient balance necessary for nitric oxide production, vascular health, and cardiovascular function. Dehydration can reduce circulation, decrease blood vessel flexibility, and disrupt NOS activity. This can cause lower levels of nitric oxide ([40](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25519003/)).
### How smoking and poor diet can deplete nitric oxide levels  
Nicotine, carbon monoxide, and other chemicals from smoking can damage your endothelial cells, reduce nitric acid production, and decrease nitric oxide levels. It can also increase oxidative stress which can result in the degradation of nitric oxide ([44](https://publications.ersnet.org/content/erj/28/2/339), [45](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1347861316300834)).  
An unhealthy diet high in refined sugar, refined oil, and ultra-processed foods, can also deprive your body of nitrates, antioxidants, and amino acids which are essential for nitric oxide synthesis. Thus a poor diet and smoking can reduce nitric oxide levels, impair vascular function, and increase the risk of high blood pressure and cardiovascular disease.
